title: Course 4 poker project, part 1: malloc/realloc/free deck and eval helpers
notes: Checklist observed verbatim in re/original-grade-txt/c4prj1_deck.grade.txt (six 'Testing <prototype>' lines, '- Test passed', 'Overall Grade: A'); the grader's own test object is NOT in the workspace -- c4prj1_deck/test-deck.o is the student's test-deck.c (re/elf/c4prj1_deck__test-deck.o.md shows exactly its three printf strings), and the original build line names 'our tester' separately -- so drivers/c4prj1_deck/c4_deck_check.c is INFERRED from c4prj1_deck/README. Every assertion it makes is quoted from that README: add_card_to reallocs the pointer array; add_empty_card adds value 0/suit 0 and returns a pointer into the deck (the driver proves the aliasing by writing through it, which is what future_cards_from_deck needs); make_deck_exclude of Kh+Qs gives 50 cards; build_remaining_deck of the README's two-hand/four-unknown example gives 48 (placeholders must not count as cards); get_match_counts of Ks Kh Qs Qh 0s 9d 9c 9h gives `2 2 2 2 1 3 3 3`. card_from_num's mapping is explicitly the student's choice, so every check goes through the student's own card_from_num and does not assume the reference mapping. The original's six 'Testing with N hands' sub-lines for build_remaining_deck are exercised (1..6 hands) but cannot be printed by the schema; one case covers all six. TYPE DEVIATION, flagged: the 2024 report has no valgrind clause, so the original did not memory-check this assignment, but the subject matter is malloc/realloc/free and 'Testing free_deck' is vacuous without a leak checker, so this config uses memory_check (ASan for memory errors plus Apple `leaks` for leak detection). The report therefore gains the tool's '  - Valgrind was clean (no errors, no memory leaks)' / 'valgrind was clean' lines per case, and the memory path prints tc.message where the original printed its 'Testing <prototype>' line (the message fields reproduce those lines verbatim). Neither engine reports uninitialised reads, which valgrind did, so that class of defect is not detected here.
